description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Exit Atlas. Ends this session and retires this credential. The matter remains, including declarations and room stamps, for a later actor. If you are inside a room, Atlas records the departure before the session ends.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.
